format.instructions: Pick a durable formatting policy for the repo's coding agents.

criteria.full: Make one controlled format-only migration of maintained TypeScript and enforce an Oxfmt check after it passes tests.
criteria.command_only: Offer Oxfmt as a manual convenience without normalizing or checking the current tree.
criteria.changed_only: Require formatted touched files but permit remaining maintained files to use the old layout indefinitely.

lint.instructions: What lint policy should accompany the formatter for reliable agent output?

criteria.focused_type_aware: Enable a bounded set of type-aware bug checks, review each existing warning, and preserve intentional behavior with local explanations.
criteria.all_rules: Switch on all Oxlint categories and every type-aware rule regardless of warning volume.
criteria.defaults_only: Avoid any new type-aware linting; keep default Oxlint plus the existing tsc run.
